worst_year.wording: among the highest (within the uncertainty band of the next year)

trend.method: Theil-Sen slope on log1p(yearly total), Mann-Kendall test (normal approx.); a trend is claimed only if p<0.05 and the fitted change exceeds the 80% band half-width

anomaly.note: Same day window in every year (partial month). Current values come from NRT data and are provisional.
